name: nz-akahu-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Akahu open-finance API (NZ). 14 tools, read-only by default, runs locally over stdio.

akahu_user_token.title: Akahu User Token
akahu_user_token.description: User token from https://my.akahu.nz/developers. Stored in your OS credential store.

akahu_app_token.title: Akahu App Token
akahu_app_token.description: App token from https://my.akahu.nz/developers. Stored in your OS credential store.

akahu_read_only.title: Read-only mode
akahu_read_only.description: Refuse all write tools when 'true'. Leave as 'true' unless you specifically need refresh/verify/report writes.

akahu_automation_bypass.title: Automation bypass
akahu_automation_bypass.description: Skip per-call consent prompts for safe-to-automate writes (account refresh only). Requires read-only=false.
